identity.name: @epdoc/exif
identity.purpose: Read/write EXIF metadata via the exiftool binary (thin wrapper + schema + DateTime helpers)

quickStart.pattern: new Exiftool() → getInfo(paths) → File.getMetadata(); File setters + write() for updates

exports.name: Exiftool
exports.description: Factory for bulk EXIF reads; returns File instances
exports.whenToUse: Reading metadata for one or more files in one invocation

exports.name: File
exports.description: Wraps a single file's EXIF metadata and provides setters/write support
exports.whenToUse: Reading or writing tags on a specific file

exports.name: getMetaDateTime
exports.description: Primary DateTime from a metadata object (original → digitized → modified)
exports.whenToUse: Get the recording/creation date of a file

exports.name: getCreatedDateTime
exports.description: Creation DateTime from a metadata object (DateTimeOriginal → CreateDate / DateCreated)
exports.whenToUse: When you specifically need the creation timestamp

exports.name: getDigitizedDateTime
exports.description: Digitization DateTime from a metadata object (CreateDate / DateCreated)
exports.whenToUse: When you specifically need the digitization timestamp

exports.name: getModifiedDateTime
exports.description: Modification DateTime from a metadata object (ModifyDate → file-system dates)
exports.whenToUse: When you specifically need the modification timestamp

exports.name: buildExifDateTime
exports.description: DateTime from a base date tag + sub-second/tz tags
exports.whenToUse: Parsing exiftool date tags into a DateTime

exports.name: parseExifTzOffset
exports.description: Convert an ISO offset to intuitive signed minutes

exports.name: formatDateTimeToExif
exports.description: Format a DateTime as exiftool's 'YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS'
exports.whenToUse: Preparing DateTime values for exiftool write args

exports.name: formatExifDateTime
exports.description: Format date components into exiftool's canonical form

exports.name: parseExifJson
exports.description: Normalize `exiftool -j` stdout (object or array) to an array

exports.name: ExifToolMediaMetadata
exports.description: Typed JSON exiftool emits for one file (precise GPS/duration types)

exports.name: ExifDateTimeResult
exports.description: DateTime parsed from EXIF plus raw milliseconds and timezone info
